title: memoize of a unary function raises IndexError when called with a keyword argument
property: a memoized function can be called in every way the original can, and returns the same result
actual: IndexError: tuple index out of range at toolz/functoolz.py:444 (key returns args[0] but args is empty)
evidence: memoize wraps arbitrary functions (docstring: 'Cache a function's result'), and its docs discuss kwargs handling; f(a=0) is valid for the original. The default key for unary functions unconditionally uses args[0], ignoring that the sole parameter may be passed by keyword.
